posts.text: [Image] A composite-style political image shows Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping standing side by side on a balcony, with Melania Trump and another woman behind them. U.S. and Chinese flags flank the group, and a presidential seal is visible on the railing. Large text above reads “AMERICA IS BACK!” with an underline beneath it.

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 26, 2026
posts.text: [Image] Donald Trump and Xi Jinping stand on a red carpet in front of a large Air China passenger jet, with Trump raising a hand in salute and Xi standing beside him. A woman stands behind them with her hand over her chest. A fighter jet flies overhead, while the words “Only Trump” and a ring of stars appear in the sky.

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 26, 2026
posts.text: [Image] An infographic titled “Days With Crude Oil Above $100” shows portraits of Barack Obama, Donald Trump, Joe Biden, and Donald Trump. It lists 308 days for 2009–2017 under Obama, 0 for 2017–2021 under Trump, 83 for 2021–2025 under Biden, and 24 for 2025–present under Trump. Each figure wears a suit and American flag pin.

posts.text: [Image] Donald Trump and Melania Trump walk hand in hand out of a White House doorway onto a red carpet. Trump wears a dark suit with a pink tie, while Melania wears a black fitted coat and matching skirt. Two uniformed U.S. Marines stand on either side of the entrance, saluting.

posts.text: [Image] A map graphic of the Persian Gulf shows Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, Iran, Oman, and the United Arab Emirates. A circled narrow waterway near Iran is highlighted, with a line pointing to a dark-blue banner labeled “TRUMP STRAIT.” The surrounding gulf is shaded blue, and country borders and names are marked in black.
